chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said:
The fresh fish melts the body.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of eating fresh fish on the body according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies fresh fish as having a 'melting' effect on the body, a concept rooted in traditional Islamic medicine (Tibb) where fresh seafood is considered highly perishable and potentially heavy or difficult to digest if not consumed immediately. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on practical health guidelines derived from the Imams, linking dietary habits to physical vitality and the preservation of bodily strength.
